industry: Non-animal toxicology testing and safety assessment
summary: Företag 7 develops and provides non-animal testing technologies and services for chemical safety assessment. Its proprietary GARD platform is used for evaluating sensitization and other toxicological endpoints for industries including chemicals, cosmetics and pharmaceuticals.
target_market: Global toxicology testing and safety assessment market
strategy_notes: Focused on expanding adoption of its GARD platform, broadening its testing portfolio and strengthening its international presence through acquisitions and commercial partnerships.
technology_notes: Combines genomics, bioinformatics and machine learning in in vitro testing platforms designed to replace or reduce animal testing in toxicity assessment.
risk_notes: Dependent on regulatory acceptance of alternative testing methods, customer adoption, integration of acquisitions and competition within the safety assessment and toxicology market.
